# Online Text Tools — Case Converter, Word Counter & String Utilities

> Online Text Tools is a comprehensive text manipulation suite to convert letter cases, sort lines, eliminate duplicate and empty lines, count words and reading time, and extract regex data.

Website: https://text-tools.corelumetech.in/
Developer & Publisher: Corelume Tech (https://corelumetech.in)
Privacy Policy: 100% Client-Side Processing. No user data, files, or strings are collected, stored, or transmitted to any server.

## Overview
Online Text Tools is a comprehensive text manipulation suite to convert letter cases, sort lines, eliminate duplicate and empty lines, count words and reading time, and extract regex data.

## Core Features
- Letter case conversion (UPPERCASE, lowercase, smart Title Case)
- Alphabetical Line Sorting and Line Reversal operations
- Instant Duplicate Line Remover and Empty Line Stripper
- Space compressor and line break flattener (Single Line converter)
- Automated Regex Data Extractor for emails and URLs
- Live text statistics: Word count, Character count, Sentences, Paragraphs, Reading Time (200 wpm), Speaking Time (130 wpm)
- Top 5 Keyword Density analyzer with frequency percentages

## Benchmarks & Technical Specifications
- Processes 100,000+ words in under 50 milliseconds
- 7 Line and whitespace manipulation tools in a single click
- Real-time statistical calculation without lag
- 100% Browser-based text processing with complete data confidentiality
